title: Moharram na bhoolna
body:
Moharram na bhoolna
Dua e fatima zehra ka tumpe saaya hai..(2)
Imam e Jafar e sadiq ne ye bataya hai
karna khushi bhi lekin..(2)
ye ghum na bhoolna..
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhoolna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ghar mein khuda dikhaye tumhare koi khushi
shadi ho wo bete ki ya beti ki rukhsati
tum bewa e qasim ka..(2)
kabhi ghum na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Qayam karo sabeelein azadaro har jagah
kausar se kam nahi hai ye paani sabeel ka
jaari hai iss sabeel mein..(2)
zam zam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Baqir ke laadle ka imamat ke phool ka
farman hai ye Sadiq e Aal e rasool ka
jaise ghadeer bhoole..(2)
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saqqa banao baccho'n ko ghazi ki yaad mein
bachpan se hi alam ko utha kar wo chal sakein
dooba hua lahu mein..(2)\
parcham na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aaram ke wo din ho ya sakhti ki raat ho
ehsaas karbala ka hamesha hi saath ho
tum maqtal e hussain ka mausam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Har haal mein bichana hai farshe ghum e hussain
milta hai isse Fatema Zehra ke dil ko chayn
zakhme dil e batool ka..(2)
marham na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bedi ho hathkadi ho, ya taboot aur alam
saare tabarrukat e hussaini hai mohtaram
tazeem inki tum bani..(2)
Adam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Jab apni betiyo'n ko karo pyaar momino
shabbir ki yateema ka matam kiya karo
khati rahi tamache wo..(2)
har dam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Kufe ke raasto'n mein kabhi shehr e shaam mein
bazaar e aam mein kabhi darbaar e aam mein
beparda thi jo ghairate...(2)
Maryam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Wajib hai tumpe Mesum o Salman Azmi
matam ki janamaz bichaye jo matami
nauho'n ki tum azaan pe..(2)
matam na bhoolna
<<MINI>>
Moharram na bhulna.. Ya hussain..(4)
